clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope — Gives specifications for hexagon nuts style 1, with thread diameters from M1.6, to M64,  with product grade A for threads d ≤ M16 and product grade B for  d > M16.

clauses.title: Threads Preferred throads –M1.6,
clauses.text: 2.1 Threads Preferred throads -M1.6, M2, M2.5, M3, M4, M5, M6, M8, M10, M12, M16, M20, M24, M30, M36, M42, M48, M56 and M64.

clauses.title: Non
clauses.text: 2.2 Non - preferred threads - M3.5, M14, M18, M22, M27, M33, M39, M45, M52, M60. Note—For  details, of preferred and non preferred sizes refer to Tables 1 and 2 of the Standard.

clauses.title: Specifications
clauses.text: 3. Specifications — See Table 1 SUMMARY OF IS 1364 (Part 3) : 2002 ISO 4032 : 1999 HEXAGON HEAD BOLTS, SCREWS AND NUTS OF PRODUCT GRADES A & B PART 3 : HEXAGON NUTS (SIZE RANGE M1.6 TO M64) (Fourth Revision) For detailed information, refer to IS 1364(PART 3) :1992.Specification for  ISO 4032:1986 Hexagon head bolts,screw and nuts  of product grades A and B— Part 3— Hexagon nuts (Size range M1.6 to M64) (third revision).
